title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on mod.rs
description: patch_file failed with 'error applying hunk #1' on src/moeb/src/tools/mod.rs. Recovered via write_file. Likely cause: CRLF/LF line-ending mismatch on Windows causing context line mismatches in diffy.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and fix patch_file hunk relocation logic for CRLF files on Windows, or normalise line endings before applying diffs.

title: Pre-existing test regression: standard_registry_has_ten_tools expects 18 but gets 19
description: tools::tests::standard_registry_has_ten_tools was already failing before this run. standard() has 19 tools but the test asserts 18, causing cargo test to exit non-zero on every run.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to update the count assertion in tool_executor_tests.rs to match the actual standard() registry size and establish a convention to keep it current.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash to run 'cargo build --release' and 'cargo test' for binary-builds and all-tests-pass rubric verification. No moeb equivalent exists. This causes a mandatory moeb-tool-origin fail on every run requiring build/test verification.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_command tool covering shell command execution for build and test verification.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (kernel result file)
description: Used Claude Code Read tool to read the oversized mcp__moeb__start_run result file written to a temp path. No moeb tool exists to retrieve kernel-generated file artifacts by path.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a tool for reading kernel-generated result artifact paths, or increase start_run result size limits.

title: fix_signal.prompt does not pre-load Reviewer/Moderator/QA Architect personas
description: fix_signal.skill.md Phase 8 instructs the agent to act as a QA Architect, but fix_signal.prompt does not inject the persona role files. End-of-skill review quality depends on the model's built-in understanding rather than project-specific persona definitions.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.rs to load reviewer/moderator/qa-architect roles and substitute them into fix_signal.prompt, following the start_run.rs pattern.
